assumptions.mesh_resolution: Highest resolution PLY in each downloaded archive; paper does not identify exact PLY.
assumptions.downsample: Uniform vertices without replacement, independently per trial; paper does not specify sampling algorithm or reuse.
assumptions.normalize: After downsampling, subtract per-axis minima and divide all axes by maximum extent; preserve shape, fit [0,1]^3.
assumptions.scale: Continuous uniform [1,5]; paper specifies range only.
assumptions.rotation: Haar SO(3), normalized iid Gaussian quaternion.
assumptions.translation: Uniform volume of origin-centered unit ball.
assumptions.outliers: Uniform volume of origin-centered radius-5 ball; replace uniformly selected distinct target indices.
assumptions.precision: Store shared input as float32. TEASER consumes exact float64 promotion; Ours consumes float32. No geometric differences.
assumptions.boxplot: All finite estimates (including inaccurate ones), median/Q1/Q3, 1.5 IQR whiskers and all fliers. Invalid models shown in separate count panel; all-trial error mean is +inf for any failure. Exact author plotting script unavailable.
